features: DI+ and DI- calculation remains unchanged from v0.1.54; this version changes presentation only
When DI+ > DI-, only the DI+ capsule is highlighted in SState yellow and DI- stays neutral
When DI- > DI+, only the DI- capsule is highlighted in SState purple and DI+ stays neutral
When DI+ equals DI- or either value is unavailable, both capsules stay neutral/uncolored
Hovering the 30-day DMI panel recalculates the capsule highlight from the hovered day's DI+/DI- values
DI+ and DI- chart strokes are reduced from 2.15 to 1.45 for a lighter visual weight
Python engine, indicator formula, S-state scoring, probability, Worker/R2, workflows, sector flow, news and learning logic are unchanged
